hints.title: Reachability in DAG
hints.text: The problem asks whether course u is an indirect or direct prerequisite of course v, which is reachability in a directed acyclic graph.

hints.title: Transitive Closure
hints.text: Compute the reachability matrix using Floyd-Warshall in O(V^3) or topological sort with bitset propagation in O(V * (V + E)).

hints.title: Answer Queries in O(1)
hints.text: For each query [u, v], query the precomputed reachable table: reachable[u][v].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a full search from scratch for each query takes O(Q * (V + E)) which is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing all-pairs reachability via Floyd-Warshall takes O(V^3) and allows O(1) query answering.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate notices V <= 100 and applies Floyd-Warshall transitive closure or topological bitset propagation.
